title: Deterministic scenario ranking/scoring over explicit assumption-sets (contract-free; consumes derive.py; named objective, stable order, transparent breakdown; never invents scenarios, never Verified)
objective: Add a pure, deterministic, OFFLINE service function (new module services/api/app/scenario/ranking.py) that ranks a set of EXPLICITLY-declared assumption-sets for one scenario document and returns an ORDERED list of scored candidates for the Compare UI's 'ranked cards + score breakdown'. HARD BOUNDARIES (AI-boundary + honesty): (1) It ranks ONLY the caller-provided explicit assumption-sets - each fed through the accepted derive_practical_usable_range to get an illustrative range - and NEVER invents, fabricates, or adds a scenario/assumption/alternative (the deterministic engine still emits one scenario; ranking orders explicit variants only). An empty assumption-set list -> a single-candidate ranking of the raw scenario (or a typed empty result), never a fabricated alternative. (2) The OBJECTIVE is an EXPLICIT caller input (e.g. an enum like maximize_illustrative_usable_area) defined in ranking.py (contract-free, do NOT edit models.py); a 'best'/top candidate is NEVER shown without NAMING that objective (docs/PRODUCT_FLOW_AND_AI_BOUNDARIES.md). (3) Scores are computed ONLY from already-surfaced numbers (the derived range / the canonical draft cap transported verbatim) - never recompute a legal value, never a hidden weight; each candidate carries its objective (named) + score + the transparent score COMPONENTS. (4) TOTAL, STABLE tie-break: identical input -> byte-identical ordered output; ties resolved by a documented deterministic secondary key so ordering never varies. (5) Fail closed: a no_scenario/unsupported document, a malformed/non-finite objective, or a malformed assumption-set -> a typed outcome (empty ranking + visible reason, or invalid), no crash, strict-JSON-safe (no NaN/Inf/negative), never a fabricated score. (6) Coverage never rises above conditional; no field == verified; needs_review + not_verified_disclaimer preserved end-to-end; scores are ILLUSTRATIVE (from the draft cap), never presented as a Verified/feasible ranking. (7) Contract-free: only ranking.py + its export in __init__.py + its test file; consume derive.py / build_scenario / the scenario document READ-ONLY; do NOT edit builder.py/models.py/constants.py/contract.py/derive.py or packages/contracts/**. Deterministic, no I/O, no Supabase/Geoclient/network. TOOL DISCIPLINE: orient with Read/Grep/Glob; do NOT use Bash for git/ls/cat/find; only WRITE files in allowed_paths and RUN documented_test_commands; the orchestrator commits at the gate.
business_reason: M5 scenario/optimization-engine DEPTH (D-038-R003 menu) and the next substantial no-creds backend feature the owner chose 2026-09-08 ('keep building offline'). Delivers the 'ranked scenario cards + optimized-objective score breakdown' the Compare UI (M5-T004, parked) is designed to show but has no data for. Pure-Python, locally pytest-testable, not G6-blocked (deterministic illustrative math over explicit assumptions, no new legal rule). Builds on the accepted derive.py (M5-T005/M5-T006).
acceptance_scenarios: AS-1 deterministic stable ordering: identical (scenario document, objective, assumption_sets) -> byte-identical ordered output; a documented TOTAL tie-break (score desc, then a deterministic secondary key) means equal-score candidates never reorder run-to-run. Test asserts json.dumps equality across input reorderings.

AS-2 transparent named-objective score breakdown: every ranked candidate carries the NAMED objective (the explicit caller input, e.g. maximize_illustrative_usable_area), its score, and the score COMPONENTS (which already-surfaced numbers produced it); no 'best'/top candidate is emitted without the objective named; no hidden weight (test proves score is a documented function of the surfaced numbers only).

AS-3 explicit-assumption-only, never fabricates: ranking orders ONLY the caller-provided explicit assumption-sets (each run through derive_practical_usable_range); it never invents a scenario/assumption/alternative. Empty assumption_sets -> a single-candidate ranking of the raw scenario (or a typed empty result), NEVER a fabricated alternative. A candidate whose derive() returns not_derivable is ranked last / flagged, never given a fabricated score.

AS-4 fail-closed on bad input: a no_scenario/unsupported scenario document, an unknown/malformed/non-finite objective, or a malformed assumption-set -> a typed outcome (empty ranking + visible reason, or invalid), no crash, strict-JSON-safe (json.dumps allow_nan=False succeeds; no NaN/Inf/negative), never a fabricated score.

AS-5 never up-labels / never Verified: coverage never rises above conditional; exhaustive check no field == 'verified'; needs_review + not_verified_disclaimer preserved on the ranking output; scores labelled ILLUSTRATIVE (derived from the draft cap), never a Verified/feasible ranking.

AS-6 read-only consumption, no legal recompute: the scenario document + derive.py outputs are consumed READ-ONLY (input byte-unchanged after ranking; no aliasing); scores use only already-surfaced numbers (derived range / canonical cap transported verbatim), never recompute a legal/cap value.

AS-7 contract-free + offline + full regression: zero modification to packages/contracts/** or builder.py/models.py/constants.py/contract.py/derive.py; runs fully offline with fixtures (no Supabase/Geoclient/network - socket-blockable); the ENTIRE scenario suite (python -m pytest services/api/tests/scenario) stays green with the new ranking tests added and zero regression.
